article.story: CORPUS CHRISTI, Texas -- — Mekhi Wallace’s 18 points helped Texas A&M-CC defeat Dallas Christian 102-58 on Tuesday. Wallace also had seven rebounds for the Islanders (2-1). Lamin Foon scored 10 points and added five rebounds. Jason Ezeadiuguwu and Michael McLeod finished with 11 points each for the Crusaders. Kordon Henderson had 10 points, four assists and two steals. Up next Texas A&M-CC’s next game is Friday against Florida State on the road, and Dallas Christian visits UL Monroe on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
